Cyber Attack Disrupts Operations Across U.S. Agriculture Firms

A major cyber attack targeting the IT systems of several agriculture firms is causing widespread disruption across the United States, with multiple sites reporting halted operations and workers unable to access critical systems.

The incident, first detected early Tuesday morning, involves ransomware that has encrypted data and locked out users at facilities belonging to companies including Heartland AgriCo, GreenFields Harvest, and Prairie Roots Cooperative. As of Wednesday afternoon, the attack remains active, and no resolution has been announced.

Affected firms report that employees at grain processing plants and livestock facilities are unable to access scheduling, inventory management, and quality control software. “Right now, we’re operating in the dark,” said Maria Gutierrez, a site manager at Heartland AgriCo’s Iowa grain storage facility. “Everything from tracking shipments to monitoring storage conditions is offline. We’re doing our best with paper logs, but it’s not sustainable.”

Union representatives expressed concern for workers’ safety and job security during the ongoing disruption. “Our members are frustrated and anxious,” said Bill Evans, president of the Midwest Farmworkers Association. “IT systems handle everything from payroll to safety alerts. People are worried about missed paychecks and workplace risks.”

The National Agricultural Security Center has confirmed that at least a dozen firms have reported being impacted by the attack, though they caution the number could rise as more sites assess the situation. “This event underscores the vulnerability of the sector’s digital infrastructure,” said Dr. Anita Rao, a cybersecurity analyst specializing in agricultural risk.

Local officials in Nebraska, Iowa, and Illinois have urged firms to follow federal guidance and avoid paying ransoms. Investigations are ongoing, but there is currently no estimate for when normal operations will resume. For now, many agriculture sites remain at a standstill, with workers awaiting updates.
